title: Absolute value
statementMd:
Return the absolute value of `n` without calling the built-in `abs`.

**Example:** `my_abs(5)` returns `5`.
solutionMd:
```python
def my_abs(n):
    return -n if n < 0 else n
```

A conditional expression keeps it on one line.
